We offer a wide variety of professional spa facial services to meet every skin type. Learn more about the different types of facial treatments available. Our facial treatment options can address all your skin problems, from anti aging to acne treatment and more. Come by King Spa today and leave wearing your best skin!

Explore one (or more) of our facial services to find the option that best fits your skin type and desired results.

children.text:
Basic Facial

This facial provides cleansing, facial massage, and mask. This treatment is ideal for those who want a simple, relaxing facial experience.

Discovery Facial

Our standard facial. After skin analysis, our esthetician will choose the best facial for your specific skin type. Ideal for people who simply want to rejuvenate their skin without skipping on nutrition and hydration.

Hydro Dewy With LED

Great for all skin types! Add moisture and lock it in for the Korean “GLASSY SKIN” look. Wondering are LED facial treatments safe? Our guide explains the benefits and safety of LED therapy.

Relax & Soothe Facial

Best fitted for those who need more attention to soothe their skin after a day out in the sun or post treatment. Using our shea butter mask and soothing cool mask, it will help balance production of excessive oils in the skin, thereby reducing overall acne and breakouts.

Facial Treatment for Men with beard

Classic facial treatment for men with beards. Facial treatment and beard cleansing, high frequency wand on beard and moisturizing. It stimulates hair follicles, promotes blood circulation and reduces dandruff.

24K Gold Facial

Relax while your skin is treated with real 24K gold patches, gold mask and gold therapy cream. Our 24K gold facial helps the skin eliminate toxins and combats sun damage. Gold patches also reduce tired appearance and brightens up the skin by circulating blood and oxygen. Rich in minerals, it restores skin tone, cleanses and detoxifies.

Bubble To Bubble OXYJET

Time to charge the vital oxygen for the skin that breathes every moment! It helps to make the skin smooth and bright through removing impurities clogged in the skin by using micro bubbles.

ProFacial : Aqua Peel with Soothing Mask

Effective for deep cleansing and facial rejuvenation. Aqua peels are one of the most popular treatments in Korea. Unlike aggressive chemical peels which cause pain, redness and several days of flaky skin. This treatment includes an aftercare Soothing mask and decollete massage.

Water Drop Lymph Treatment

Water Drop Lift works by using high-density ultrasonic energy that increases lymph circulation and skin tightening.

Skin Plus (Pin Radio-Frequency with SONO)

An integrated skin care system for anti-aging. Helps to minimize pores, improve the skin’s volume, add deep hydration, and revitalize the skin.

Visit King Spa Today for the Ultimate Skincare Experience

Experience the ultimate rejuvenation for your skin at Kings Spa. Discover a world-class selection of facial treatments tailored to your specific needs. Our skilled estheticians use state-of-the-art techniques and premium products to enhance your natural beauty and restore a youthful glow. Whether you’re seeking deep hydration, anti-aging solutions, or a refreshing facial cleanse, our diverse range of spa facial treatments will leave you feeling refreshed and radiant.

Indulge in a transformative spa experience and book one of our  facial treatments today at Kings Spa in Virginia. Your skin deserves the royal treatment. Contact us now or get your day pass online!

Note: Facial treatments should be booked in-person at our spa and are first come, first-served.
